title: AdvanSix Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: AdvanSix Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing the appointment of Patrick C. Day as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective April 27, 2026. Day succeeds Christopher Gramm, who returns to his prior role as VP of Corporate Finance and Strategic Financial Planning and Analysis. Day's compensation includes a $530,000 base salary, 70% target short-term incentive, a $1.2 million initial equity award, and a $900,000 sign-on RSU grant.
key_points: Patrick C. Day appointed SVP and CFO, effective April 27, 2026
Day joins from FMC Corporation where he served as VP of Financial Planning and Analysis and Investor Relations since January 2024
Christopher Gramm returns to VP of Corporate Finance and Strategic FP&A after serving as Interim CFO
Target short-term incentive: 70% of base salary (prorated for 2026)
Initial long-term equity award valued at $1,200,000 to be granted in 2027 cycle
Sign-on RSU grant of $900,000 to compensate for forfeited equity from previous employer
